messages:
Maya (CS): FYI - Acme (lina@acme.com) opened a ticket: their $5k trial grant landed on an old org that they no longer use. They provisioned a new org via SSO last week. Ticket #CS-2319.

Lina (Acme Admin): Hi - I signed up last week and confirmed a promo. I only see the credit on our legacy workspace (acme-legacy). We need it on acme-prod where our traffic is.

Olga (Support): Sorry about that, Lina. Can you confirm the workspace IDs or org slugs for prod vs legacy? Also paste the email you used for SSO.

Lina (Acme Admin): Email: lina@acme.com. Workspaces: org-acme-prod (created 2026-02-18) and org-acme-legacy (created 2020-11-03). Thanks.

Samir (AcctOps): Pulled the ledger: promo_code=ACME2026_FREE5K txn_id=CREDITTX-202677 applied_to=org-acme-legacy amount=5000 created_by=promo-service. Looks like redemption applied to the legacy org.

Jordan (Engineering): I reproduced locally. Repro steps: 1) Create a user with SSO joining both workspaces 2) Call POST /v1/promos/redeem {"code":"ACME2026_FREE5K","email":"lina@acme.com"} 3) If the user has multiple workspaces we currently select the oldest workspace matching their domain (sort by created_at) -> picks org-acme-legacy.

Jordan (Engineering): Relevant log: 
```
INFO  [promo-service] redeem request email=lina@acme.com
DEBUG [workspace-lookup] matches=[org-acme-legacy, org-acme-prod]
INFO  [credit] issuing txn=CREDITTX-202677 workspace=org-acme-legacy
```
Root cause: ambiguous redemption path when SSO identity maps to multiple orgs. We don't prompt or require an explicit org_id.

Olga (Support): Customer needs this moved immediately — their launch is today. Can we do a manual remediation while engineering fixes the flow?

Samir (AcctOps): We can issue a compensating credit to the correct org and reverse the original txn. Proposed ops: 
- Create new credit txn=CREDITTX-202678 amount=5000 applied_to=org-acme-prod
- Reverse CREDITTX-202677 with note "manual reassignment CS-2319"
Need confirmation from eng that duplicate txn issuance won't break accounting invariants.

Jordan (Engineering): Confirmed — issuing a compensating credit and flagging the original as reversed is the right path. Promo service will never re-run the original txn after reversal. I'll also add a guard in promo-service to return HTTP 409 + workspace list when redemption is ambiguous.

billing-bot: Accounting action queued - ACCT-ACTION-6012 (owner=Samir)

Samir (AcctOps): Done - CREDITTX-202678 applied to org-acme-prod. CREDITTX-202677 marked reversed. General ledger notes updated: CS-2319. Lina, can you verify the balance on your end?

Lina (Acme Admin): I can see the $5k on org-acme-prod now. Thanks for the fast help.

Maya (CS): Noted. I'll message the customer with the timeline and confirm closure once audit is complete.

Jordan (Engineering): I opened PR 493 in promo-service: require_explicit_org_for_multi_workspace_users. Quick mitigation: if multiple matching workspaces, respond with 409 + choices. Longer-term: add SSO org_hint on the auth handshake. ETA staging patch: ~2 hours, prod deploy: next maintenance window (~tomorrow morning).

Olga (Support): I'll add follow-ups to the ticket: audit for similar ambiguous redemptions and confirm any other active promos that might be affected.

Samir (AcctOps): Follow-ups assigned: Samir - reconcile reversal in GL (EOD); Jordan - deploy promo-service fix (tomorrow); Olga - audit report (EOW); Maya - customer confirm (sent).

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone. Lina: closing the loop here but I'll re-open if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
